notes.base_url_is_https: HTTPS on purpose. ALTCHA solves its proof-of-work with the Web Crypto API, which browsers expose only in a secure context, so on http:// the ALTCHA widget hangs on 'Verifying...' and every ALTCHA form is unsubmittable. Running the walk over http would report a false ALTCHA failure.
notes.provider_matrix: This plugin's real risk surface is provider x context, not role x viewport. Every render/verify journey must be run for all five services (recaptcha-v2, recaptcha-v3, turnstile, hcaptcha, altcha) by switching wbc_captcha_service, because each has its own render path and its own verify().
notes.test_keys: reCAPTCHA v2, Turnstile and hCaptcha all publish always-pass test keys; ALTCHA needs only a local HMAC secret. reCAPTCHA v3 has NO public test key - a real site+secret pair registered for the test domain is required, otherwise grecaptcha.execute() rejects and no token is ever produced.
notes.no_build_release_script: This plugin packages via grunt (gruntfile.js), not bin/build-release.sh, so the build-time smoke/docs gates are not wired. Gates must be run manually per the release skill until a build-release.sh is added.
